prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, but underestimated gains from adoption new flows, choose path layouts, and home notifications.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful in three winning tests, though other placements showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow), choose path layouts (choose_path, layout), and home notifications (home, notification) were helpful in multiple winning tests.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), home hints (home, hint), and sign-in notifications (sign_in, notification) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) and finish redesigns (finish, redesign) hurt performance (causing rollbacks) or showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once, requiring at least 2 tests of that kind to establish a pattern.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Stage Layout Refresh: Transform the path selection screen into a stage layout showcasing companion paths in a structured focused view. (why: Choose path layouts have driven strong conversion gains in past winning tests, and 21.5% of users drop off at choose_path.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Audio Guided Companion Flow: Introduce an audio-guided pet preview flow on the friend selection screen to help users listen to pet voices during adoption. (why: Adoption new flows yielded proven gains in past wins, and adoption takes high median time (89s) with 24.3% dropoff.)
2: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Desktop Status Banner Notification: Display an active ready notification banner on the waiting screen when the desktop pet finish load completes. (why: Home notifications have repeatedly improved retention in prior winning tests while waiting stage takes a high mean time of 2336s.)
3: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Two Column Layout: Reformat the adoption certificate screen into a clear two-column layout highlighting pet stats alongside confirmation details. (why: Adoption layout adjustments reduce setup confusion and help lower high adoption completion time (mean 1017s).)
4: [choose_path, new_flow] Choose Path Mascot Guide Flow: Add an interactive animated mascot component to guide users through selecting their ideal pet path. (why: New interactive flows and choose path layout enhancements were highlighted in past winning tests as key drivers.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Process Time Estimate: Show structured load stage progress and time estimates on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets generate. (why: The waiting step has a high mean duration of 2336s, creating dropoff risk if user progress status is unclear.)
6: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Spotlight Redesign: Redesign the story onboarding screen using a spotlight layout to highlight companion lore and set user expectations. (why: Improving initial screens sets better expectations and reduces early dropoff at choose_path (21.5% drop).)
7: [adoption, new_screen] New Companion Summary Preview Screen: Insert a new companion summary preview screen between photo upload and adoption certificate generation. (why: Adoption has a high mean completion time (1017s) and users reported custom pet image generation confusion in support emails.)

scores.note: Choose path layout changes are proven winners across 5 prior tests with a 21.5% step dropoff to target.
Adoption new flows have strong historical backing (+2.2% across 6 tests) targeting a 24.3% dropoff step.
Home notifications consistently perform well (+2.7% across 3 tests) addressing high waiting stage time.
Adoption step has high dropoff, but adoption layout is an untested change kind requiring caution.
New flows generally succeed, but choose_path new flow specifically lacks established history.
Home wait_info shows consistent modest positive gains (+0.9% across 4 tests) addressing long load times.
Redesigns consistently underperform or cause dropoff regression across multiple target steps.
Strong evidence from funnel and support mail, but adding new screens historically hurts onboarding completion severely.
